verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Workers documentation explicitly states 'No cold starts or region complexity' and that Workers/Agents 'scale to tens of millions of instances' with pay-per-compute pricing (not wall time), directly matching the sub-second boot and massive-scale story. Community testimonials independently corroborate speed and ease ('Workers are so damn good and easy', 'fast and awesome way to bend legacy APIs'), though one thread flags CPU-time limits as a constraint for long-running (not boot/scale) workloads. Missing for 10: independent third-party load-test benchmarks with concrete boot-time/scale numbers rather than vendor claims alone.
